_comment: The one description of ProsperGenics (audit CON-13). Read by inc/site-chrome.php (footer; inc/seo.php uses it for the homepage meta, sharing tags and Organization JSON-LD) and by site_chrome.py (footer of the static pages, About page meta and sharing tags). 'short' fits a meta description (at most 160 characters); 'long' is for structured data and other places with room. Change the wording here only.
name: ProsperGenics
short: A community in Kenya and the Netherlands that creates value together: courses and certification, AI tools, services and the people behind them.
long: ProsperGenics is a community in Kenya and the Netherlands researching and practising value creation. We build, learn and measure through real projects: courses and certification, AI tools and services for organisations.
